title: Clarity
tagline: This project aims to provide AI-assisted user onboarding capabilities, leveraging the power of AI to enhance the user experience during the onboarding process. By incorporating OpenAI, the system aims to streamline and personalize the onboarding UX.
description:
Web3 is the future of the internet, and it's important that we onboard as many users as possible. One of the biggest challenges of onboarding web2 users to web3 is the issue of wallets. Many web2 users don't own a wallet, and even those who do may not know how to use it for web3 transactions.

This has resulted in a high failure rate among users using platforms like OpenSea. In fact, up to 50% of OpenSea users don't know how to work with a wallet, hence constantly encountering failed transactions. 

That's where our AI-assisted user onboarding process comes in. By combining OpenAI API with “Sign in with Lens” from Lens Protocol, we can create an onboarding process that is both intuitive and user-friendly. OpenAI API will provide AI-powered assistance that guides users through each step of the onboarding process, while “Sign in with Lens” will simplify the login process, making it easy for users to get started.
how_its_made:
Add Nouns Image API to keep the front cover of the app fine and unexpected.

Chatbot Assistance: An AI-powered chatbot is integrated to provide real-time assistance and answer user queries during onboarding.

Allow first-time users to claim Lens handles and use the option to "Sign in with Lens".

Allow first-time users to use the Safe Core onramp to purchase gas tokens on Polygon.

Enable users to mint Genesis AI Pass via Polygon Mumbai and Linea.
